newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus to auction 91-day t-bills worth 38 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus to auction 91-day t-bills worth 38 mln.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will auction up to 38 million pounds ($73.7 million) worth of 91 day treasurty bills with a July 9 issue date, the bank said on Tuesday.
Competitive no non-competitive bids for the issue can be made from July 7 to July 9 at 0900 local (0600 GMT).

The central bank defines competitive bids as those where the bidder will set the price they are willing to pay to buy the bills. The bid can be accepted in part or in whole only if the price set is equal or higher than the price set by the central bank for the specific issue.
Non-competitive bids, which have to be marked as such, are those where the bidder states his intention to purchase bills at the average price of competitive bids accepted by the central bank.
The central bank is due to auction up to 55 million pounds worth of 91-day bills on Wednesday, July 2.
Tenders for the issue can be made until 0600 GMT on Wednesday. $=0.515 pounds)
